His investments have extended from industrial businesses and telecommunications to major property projects in Vienna.

long_biography.plain_text:
Buying the Vienna bank building where he had once worked held particular meaning for investor Ronny Pecik. As a young employee he had felt intimidated by senior management; returning as its purchaser marked a change in his own circumstances. His investment approach involves acquiring shareholder rights and using them to influence how businesses are run, rather than simply waiting for share prices to rise.

Technical education also remained important to him. He helped establish the TU Wien Foundation, which supports university research, teaching and the transfer of knowledge into practical use. The university appointed him an honorary senator in recognition of that contribution. Its programme encompasses endowed professorships, scholarships and support for research infrastructure.
